summary: Worker-4/6 re-review reopened the handoff packet, primary XML/PDF, OA package members, supplementary PDF text, source CSV, locator index, linked DBAASP rows, and merged sequence/experiment/literature tables. The prior framework-test ticket is resolved by replacing scaffold activity/database/final-review outputs with source-located records while preserving database value and target conflicts as cautions.
adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed owner-layer repair completed for doi__10.1021_acs.jmedchem.3c00460. The paper is acceptable with cautions: DBAASP value-normalization differences, two database A. baumannii BAA-1605 target rows not present in local source tables, and the material-layer supplement-index gap remain visible but no longer block publication-grade review because local OA package supplement PDF/CSV was directly checked.

paper_xml.coverage: Article metadata, abstract, Tables 1-3, antimicrobial/hemolysis/cytotoxicity/serum-stability methods, figure captions, and source locators for main activity and mechanism claims.

paper_pdf.coverage: PDF text cross-check for Table 1/2 activity, MHC, Figure 3 toxicity/stability context, and supplement availability note.

oa_package.coverage: OA NXML, PDF, supplement PDF, supplement CSV, figures, GIF/JPG images, and archive manifest checked.

supplementary_assets.coverage: Supplement PDF table of contents/Table S1 and source CSV with peptide sequences, SMILES, MIC, MHC, and HEK293/A549 toxicity columns checked. supplementary_tables.json has table_count 0 but the OA package CSV supplies the structured activity table.

merged_database_rows.coverage: DBAASP assay, experiment, literature, and sequence rows reconciled against source XML tables and the OA-package supplement CSV.

supplementary_assets.note: OA package contains jm3c00460_si_001.pdf and jm3c00460_si_002.csv even though supplementary_index.json lists no separate supplementary_assets.

per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-6 replaced scaffold parser rows because they used peptide names as target species and included non-activity columns. Final activity/toxicity rows now come from source CSV jm3c00460_si_002.csv, with Table 1/2 XML cross-checks where available.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_4_database: DBAASP rows were reconciled row-by-row against source XML tables, source CSV, and merged sequence rows. Exact value matches are source_verified; rounded/mean-vs-range value differences and absent BAA-1605 target rows are retained as source_conflict with locators rather than promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_5_mechanism_context: Worker-6 bounded mechanism ontology to membrane/leakage/folding/property evidence supported by XML table/section locators and did not infer a narrower molecular target.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: The generic framework-test rework ticket is resolved after owner-layer source review. Final status is accepted_with_cautions rather than accepted_clean because preserved database conflicts and a material-index caveat remain visible.

caution_findings.record: DBAASP linked assay/experiment rows with rounded cytotoxicity values or source table ranges/means
caution_findings.note: Rows whose database values differ from the exact XML/CSV source value are retained as source_conflict with database and source values recorded; no value was fabricated or silently normalized.

caution_findings.record: DBAASP rows for Acinetobacter baumannii ATCC BAA-1605
caution_findings.note: Local XML/PDF/supplement CSV contain A. baumannii ATCC19606 and other Table 2 strains, but no BAA-1605 target. These database rows remain source_conflict, not accepted as source_verified.

supplementary_index.json reports no supplementary_assets, but the OA package contains jm3c00460_si_001.pdf and jm3c00460_si_002.csv; both were opened and used for review, so this is no longer a publication-grade blocker.
Mechanism is limited to membrane-interaction/leakage/folding/property context. No receptor/enzyme target or exact kill pathway is inferred.
The rework ticket is closed because owner-layer blockers were repaired, but source conflicts remain explicit in final artifacts.
